svg.aria-label: A calibration bench selects only a reference used by an active mechanism. A press checks genuine source evidence, a ledger retains immutable revisions, a timer and bell mark the final twenty-four hours, and an interlock stops the affected operation at expiry. An automatic refresh never renews human authority.
